name: B10-0195/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It says Armenia faces outside interference, cyberattacks and false information, especially before its elections on 7 June 2026. It asks Armenia to protect its democracy better, with stronger rules, clearer political funding and work with independent groups. It welcomes a new EU mission to Armenia and asks EU countries to give it enough money and staff. It also calls for free and fair elections.

- The EU sets up a second mission in Armenia to advise on fighting interference and cyberattacks.
- It affects Armenian voters, institutions and civil society ahead of the June 2026 elections.
- Next: EU countries should fund the mission; Armenia should strengthen its safeguards.
